subject: Comp band uplift + spot bonus approval for Sr Backend IC
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Comp band uplift + spot bonus approval for Sr Backend IC

Vivek / Dylan —

Quick note: Priya (Senior Backend IC, Eng Infra) has consistently outperformed her peers this cycle, leading the KV cache optimization effort that reduced median latency by ~30% on long-tail requests. I discussed career banding with Priya last week; she remains individual-contributor focused and is not taking a manager track.

Ask: I am proposing a band uplift from L5 -> L6 (title stays Senior Backend Engineer) plus a one-time spot bonus to bridge the gap until next equity refresh. Numbers are in the attached comp_change_form.pdf; high level: base uplift ~12%, spot bonus ~$12k (pre-tax). I’ve attached a short performance summary and a completed comp change form for approvals.

Business rationale: her contribution materially reduces infra costs and customer latency; losing her would create a significant product risk. We discussed retention packages with Talent Acquisition and this is the leanest path that aligns with our comp bands.

Can you confirm approval to proceed with Payroll/PeopleOps? If helpful I can share the technical impact deck. Next steps after approval: Neha will coordinate offer paperwork and payroll timing.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Core Services
Redwood Inference

Attachment: comp_change_form.pdf (application/pdf, 48KB)
Attachment: performance_summary-priy_r.txt (text/plain, 6KB)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Nov 2025 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Comp band uplift + spot bonus approval for Sr Backend IC

Thanks for the context, Marissa. I read the summary and the latency slides — excellent impact. Couple of clarifying questions before I sign off:

- Is the uplift intended to be permanent base increase (yes per form) and will the band change be reflected in the title/job code for headcount reporting?
- Spot bonus timing: do you want it paid this payroll cycle or next? If this cycle, we need final signoff today for payroll cutoffs (payroll cut is EOD Wed PST).
- Any internal candidates or comp precedents we should be mindful of? I recall we gave a similar uplift to an infra IC in Q1.

If answers are yes/this cycle/none unusual, approve from me pending legal review on the comp-change wording. Please loop Andrew from Legal for a final quick pass.

Vivek
VP, Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Nov 2025 13:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Comp band uplift + spot bonus approval for Sr Backend IC

Marissa —

I support the uplift. From a budgeting perspective: we have headroom in Q4 IC comp adjustment pool (~$95k left) and the base uplift + spot bonus fits within that if approved before the payroll window. If you want the spot this cycle we need a signed comp change + doc for payroll by EOD Wed.

I’ll flag this with Payroll and tag it high-priority. Neha — once you have the final numbers I’ll reserve the budget line.

Dylan
Head of Finance Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma PeopleOps <emma@peopleops-adv.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Nov 2025 08:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Comp band uplift + spot bonus approval for Sr Backend IC

Thanks team —

I’ve reviewed the form and the performance summary. Two notes from PeopleOps:
1) For permanent banding we need the updated job code and the manager justification field completed (I filled a draft line in the form; Marissa please confirm).
2) For spot bonus, payroll requires the compensation change request and signed manager approval attached to the payroll ticket. Payroll cutoff for Nov 14 pay run is Fri 11/7 2pm PST if you want it in the Nov 14 check (we can also target Dec).

I’ve looped Emma from our PeopleOps vendor for any nuance on equity timing if we decide to accelerate token refresh discussions. Emma — are there any limits on accelerating the equity refresh for high-performers this cycle?

Neha Kapoor
People Operations Partner
Redwood Inference
From: Andrew Legal <andrew.legal@outsidecounsel.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Nov 2025 15:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Comp band uplift + spot bonus approval for Sr Backend IC

On Wed, Nov 5, 2025 at 08:34 AM Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks team —
>
> I’ve reviewed the form and the performance summary. Two notes from PeopleOps:
> 1) For permanent banding we need the updated job code and the manager justification field completed (I filled a draft line in the form; Marissa please confirm).
> 2) For spot bonus, payroll requires the compensation change request and signed manager approval attached to the payroll ticket.

All looks fine from Legal. Standard guidance: ensure the manager justification does not commit to future promotions or guaranteed increases beyond what’s in the form, and keep the wording consistent with the job code change. I’ve attached a one-paragraph redline for the comp_change_form.pdf that clarifies the terms.

Approve to proceed once Marissa confirms the manager justification language and signs the final form. If you prefer, I can add the redline directly to DocuSign for faster turnaround.

Andrew Senior Counsel
Outside Counsel for Redwood Inference
